policy.pass_definition: The exact requested scalar is present; visible Taiwan Traditional topology agrees with current CNS mapping and stroke-sequence structure; the glyph remains directly recognizable at native, 128, 64, and 32 px cell sizes; ink clears the grid; no stray thorn, wrong hook, missing or extra semantic stroke is visible.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified or incompatible variant, missing or extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong hook, unreadability at a reviewed size, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn-like defect is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster establishes visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated dark authored ink only. Grid lines, near-white background variation, antialias halos, and CNS copybook outlines are forbidden geometry.

legal_small_components.finding: visible intended dot strokes in the two 糸 components; not debris

authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no reference outline, coordinate, or trace enters the image-generated glyph

views: generated cell beside independently rasterized CNS TW-Kai
method.grid_detection: Five long light-gray line groups on each axis were detected by projection. Clearance is the minimum pixel distance from ink with luminance L<100 to the nearest detected grid-line centre.
method.stray_component_detection: Inside each grid cell, L<100 pixels were grouped by 8-connectivity. The smallest component is 89 px. The only components below 100 px are the two visually confirmed legal 糸 dot strokes in 灣, with areas 89 and 91 px.

method.background_note: The four sheets are visually clean but not numerically flat white. The standard deviation of pixels with L>=245 ranges from 1.17 to 1.28, so background normalization remains mandatory before tracing.
